attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') into the bulletin, which breaks character. It also gives most of its space to old news, framing the raids as an ongoing pattern. The prose is flat ('It is now day 47') with little of Brask's sardonic voice, and at about 75 words it falls short of the 80-word minimum."}
